elements.label: Agent reply bubble growing from a small pill

pattern.description: The chat thread nudges upward to make room while the agent's reply bubble grows out of a tiny pill (like a typing indicator) into a small bubble and then stretches wide; the reply text starts word by word with 'Yes,' as the voice says it.
pattern.why_premium: The bubble is born from a typing-indicator pill instead of simply appearing, and its width morph plus the thread push-up read as a live conversation; text is gated to the spoken words.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.thread', {y: -100, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); tl.fromTo('.reply', {width: 32, height: 20, opacity: 0, borderRadius: 999}, {opacity: 1, width: 70, height: 50, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<0.2').to('.reply', {width: 400, height: 150, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}); words of '.reply-text' fade in at narration timestamps (opacity 0->1, 0.12s).
build_hint.remotion: Thread translateY via spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 140}); reply bubble width/height driven by a second spring({damping: 22, stiffness: 180}) starting a few frames later from a pill size; reply words opacity interpolate keyed to word start frames.

notes: Camera verdict none; pan_y -0.15 is the thread scrolling inside the frame. Pattern could also be read as chip/notification pop for the bubble birth.
